budget.notes: Same family budget as the Telluride hunt. Used minivans run pricier — the in-budget plays are a high-mileage Odyssey EX-L (~$24k) or a 2022 Carnival LX (~$22.5k). Sienna and Pacifica Hybrid stretch to ~$26k-$40k; keep those as references, not targets.

financing.strategy: Get PRE-APPROVED (not fully funded) before visiting dealers. Walk in with the rate locked; make the dealer beat 4.99% or keep them out of financing entirely.
financing.note: Same financing plan as the Telluride hunt.

trimPrimer.seatsConfig: 8-pass via Magic Slide 2nd row (no captain's-chair penalty)
trimPrimer.budgetFit: realistic (high-miles EX-L lands ~$24k — the in-budget play)

trimPrimer.seatsConfig: 8-pass uses a NARROW middle seat (not a full bench); 7-pass captain's chairs available
trimPrimer.warning: The 8-passenger Carnival's middle seat is a narrow add-in, not a true bench like the Sienna/Pacifica. Sit three across before you commit.

trimPrimer.seatsConfig: 8-pass bench OR 7-pass captain's chairs — but HYBRID has no Stow 'n Go
trimPrimer.warning: Pacifica Hybrid (PHEV) loses Stow 'n Go — the battery sits where the seats would fold into the floor. Pre-2019 cars had transmission/electrical recalls; 2021+ is much improved.

checklistTemplate: Decide the seat layout: true 8-pass bench (Sienna/Pacifica) vs Odyssey Magic Slide vs Carnival narrow-middle
Test BOTH power sliding doors + the power liftgate (sensors/motors are a common fail)
Hybrid? Check battery health + remaining warranty (Pacifica PHEV has NO Stow 'n Go)
Run the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and confirm all recalls are closed
Sienna: confirm AWD vs FWD if AWD matters to you
Pacifica: pull transmission + electrical service history (esp. older years)
Carnival: test all electrical — headlights, keyless entry, wipers, BCM
Odyssey: test infotainment + the Magic Slide 2nd-row mechanism
Brakes, 12V battery age, and fluid/service records
Show the credit union 4.99% pre-approval; make them beat it

knownIssues.siennaClimate: Some Siennas report AC compressor / blower-motor issues; otherwise the reliability benchmark of the group.
knownIssues.odysseyDoorsInfotainment: Power sliding-door sensors/motors and older infotainment glitches are the usual Odyssey gripes. Test every door cycle.
knownIssues.carnivalElectrical: Carnival's common trouble spots are electrical — headlights, cruise, keyless entry, wiper motor, body control module. Exercise all of it.
knownIssues.pacificaMechanical: Pacifica: motor mounts, tie-rods, alternator, EGR valve. 2017-2018 had heavy transmission/steering recall populations; 2021+ much improved.
knownIssues.pacificaStowNGo: PHEV trades Stow 'n Go for the floor battery — confirm you can live without fold-flat 2nd-row storage.
knownIssues.recallsAllModels: Every model: run the VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before buying and confirm completed work.
